verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for a self-hostable SaaS email app with a developer surface, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Zero documents no public HTTP API; its only API-adjacent surface is a prose MCP capability list with no endpoint schema. Nothing in the pack mentions API versions or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
